event_settings_couple_names.name: event_settings_couple_names
event_settings_couple_names.value: cardinality("event_settings"."couple_names") = 2 and array_position("event_settings"."couple_names", null) is null and array_ndims("event_settings"."couple_names") = 1 and length(trim("event_settings"."couple_names"[1])) between 1 and 200 and length(trim("event_settings"."couple_names"[2])) between 1 and 200

event_settings_order_limits.name: event_settings_order_limits
event_settings_order_limits.value: "event_settings"."max_open_orders_per_table" between 1 and 100 and "event_settings"."order_cooldown_seconds" between 0 and 86400 and "event_settings"."max_item_quantity" between 1 and 100

event_settings_cutoff_timezone.name: event_settings_cutoff_timezone
event_settings_cutoff_timezone.value: "event_settings"."rsvp_lock_at" is null or "event_settings"."time_zone" is not null

staff_pin_credential_complete.name: staff_pin_credential_complete
staff_pin_credential_complete.value:
("staff"."pin_hash" is null and "staff"."pin_issued_at" is null and "staff"."pin_expires_at" is null)
      or
      ("staff"."pin_hash" is not null and "staff"."pin_issued_at" is not null and "staff"."pin_expires_at" is not null
       and "staff"."pin_expires_at" > "staff"."pin_issued_at" and "staff"."role" <> 'admin'
       and "staff"."pin_hash" ~ '^scrypt[$][1-9][0-9]{0,6}[$][1-9][0-9]{0,3}[$][1-9][0-9]{0,3}[$][0-9a-f]{32,128}[$]([0-9a-f]{2}){32,128}$')
